adminPathsCombinedHint: With both, an address outside the list gets a 403 before it is asked for a password.
adminPathsDesc: Restrict the sign-in and admin pages of this site to chosen addresses or to a password. The rest of the site stays public.
adminPathsExceptions: Stays public because the site front end calls it: {{paths}}
adminPathsIpsHint: Everyone else gets a 403. Include your own address, or you will lock yourself out of these pages.
adminPathsIpsLabel: Allowed IPs or CIDR ranges (one per line)
adminPathsPasswordHint: Only a bcrypt hash is kept on the server, so the password cannot be shown again. Enter it again whenever you change this restriction.
adminPathsRateHint: The brute-force guard bans an address that goes over this on the protected paths, on the whole server. It needs the guard agent installed and up to date. Images, scripts and styles are not counted.
adminPathsRemoved: Restriction removed. Normal access is restored.
adminPathsSingleHint: This server's Operations Engine supports one protection at a time. Update it to combine them or to add a request limit.
adminPathsStateRate: Request limit: {{max}} per {{window}} min, then a {{ban}} min ban
adminPathsStateUnknown: Unknown: the current setting could not be read from the server.
adminPathsUnsupported: This server's Operations Engine cannot restrict admin paths yet. Update the engine first.
adminPathsUnsupportedKind: No admin paths are known for this kind of site.
adminPathsUseAllowlist: Only these addresses may open them
headersInfoNote: Headers are added to the Caddyfile and applied after save. Changes require no downtime.
hstsDesc: Forces browsers to use HTTPS for 1 year. Only enable on sites with valid SSL.
ipAclDesc: "Allow only these" blocks everyone else with a 403. "Block these" lets everyone else through.
noIps: No IPs configured. Add one below.
referrerPolicyDesc: Sends the full URL as referrer for same-origin requests; only the origin for cross-origin.
validationError: Enter a valid IP address or CIDR (e.g. 203.0.113.4 or 10.0.0.0/8)
xContentTypeOptionsDesc: Stops browsers from MIME-sniffing responses away from the declared content-type.
xFrameOptionsDesc: Prevents your site from being embedded in iframes on other origins (clickjacking protection).
